scenes: This man has two guesses left. Then half a billion dollars is gone. Forever.
In twenty eleven, he made a short video explaining Bitcoin.
As a thank-you, a fan paid him seven thousand bitcoin.
He locked the keys on a tiny USB drive called an Iron Key.
The Iron Key gives you ten tries. After that, it scrambles everything.
He tried eight times. Eight times wrong.
Those coins are now worth over five hundred million dollars.
In twenty twenty-three, a security firm said it could crack the drive.
He turned them down. He was already working with other experts.
Two guesses left. What would you try?
